seoDescription: 3 door wardrobe (almari) made to your wall size with plenty of hanging and shelf space. Starting price {price}. {name}.
paras: A wardrobe works best when it fits your wall and the way you store your clothes. Our 3 door wardrobe starts at 150 cm wide, 60 cm deep and 210 cm tall, with space for hanging clothes and shelves for folded ones.

Tell us the width and height of your wall and we will plan the inside with you: more hanging space, more shelves, or drawers. You can also choose the door style, the finish and the handles. A depth of about 55 to 60 cm is enough for hanging clothes, and we will make sure the doors can open fully in your room.
faq: Can the wardrobe go up to the ceiling?
Yes. Send us the height of your room and we will make it to fit.
Can you change the inside layout?
Yes. We can add more hanging space, shelves or drawers to suit how you store your clothes.
